rows.query: What are the regular holidays in 2026?
rows.prompt:
PUBLIC RECORD:
Proclamation No. 1006 sets ten regular holidays for 2026. New Year's Day is 2026-01-01. Maundy Thursday is 2026-04-02. Good Friday is 2026-04-03. Araw ng Kagitingan is 2026-04-09. Labor Day is 2026-05-01. Independence Day is 2026-06-12. National Heroes Day is 2026-08-31. Bonifacio Day is 2026-11-30. Christmas Day is 2026-12-25. Rizal Day is 2026-12-30. Separate proclamations cover Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha. Source: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/7/99678 (checked 2026-10-09).
